- [USER] User asked for tips on staying motivated to work out in the morning, especially on days when they don't feel like it.

- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] List of tips for staying motivated to work out in the morning:

  2. Create a morning routine
  3. Find an exercise you enjoy
  4. Vary your routine
  5. Get accountability
  6. Reward yourself
  7. Focus on how you feel
  8. Prepare everything the night before
  9. Make it convenient
  10. Be kind to yourself
  11. Visualize success
  12. Get enough sleep
  13. Make it a habit
  14. Find a workout that fits your lifestyle
  15. Celebrate small wins
